caption: The video showcases a wooden floor laid out with several parallel domino runs of blue-based pieces, most topped with a single color. Curved blue connectors and plain blue segments join the runs into a serpentine path. A loose scatter of flat green dominoes sits above them, and the camera remains fixed throughout. At the start the upper orange-topped run is already mostly toppled, and only a few upright orange pieces remain at its far left. These lean and fall flat within the first moments, after which that run stays still. Meanwhile the red-topped run, fully upright at first, begins to tilt at its left end, and a falling front travels steadily left-to-right along its length, while the bottom orange run and the top green scatter show no change. As the red front reaches the right-hand curve, the green-topped run below it starts toppling from its right end, the fall propagating right-to-left, so that by the last frame only the rightmost green pieces are down.
